note: Share estimates removed/marked unreliable: sample was biased toward my collections

categories.name: Work & AI Tools
categories.definition: Productivity software, AI tools, presentation tricks, and tech hacks to optimize daily work and tasks.
include: Software tools, AI apps, website recommendations
PowerPoint/presentation tricks, productivity hacks
Workflow automation, AI prompts, Excel/Notion tips
exclude: Software programming/code writing (goes to Coding & Tech Development)
Machine learning/data science code (goes to Coding & Tech Development)

categories.name: Coding & Tech Development
categories.definition: Programming tutorials, software development, web dev, machine learning, and GitHub projects.
include: Writing code, programming languages (Python, JS, C++, etc.)
Machine learning, deep learning, AI algorithms
Web development, open-source repositories, GitHub, developer tools
exclude: Generic non-coding productivity apps or AI tools (goes to Work & AI Tools)

categories.name: Career & Interview Prep
categories.definition: Job search strategies, resume building, interview preparation, placement tips, and salary negotiation.
include: Resume/CV building, LinkedIn optimization
Coding interview questions, behavioral interview tips
Job hunting, career growth, internship/placement advice
exclude: Sales & freelancing client outreach (goes to Sales & Business Growth)

categories.name: Sales & Business Growth
categories.definition: Entrepreneurship, freelancing, cold outreach, trading, marketing, and business scaling.
include: Sales scripts, cold messaging, client closing tips
Freelancing, agency business, e-commerce, trading/investing strategies
Marketing strategy, agency scaling
exclude: Job interview / corporate resume tips (goes to Career & Interview Prep)

categories.name: Calisthenics & Bodyweight Training
categories.definition: Reserved strictly for bodyweight and street workout content.
include: Bodyweight skills, planches, muscle-ups, street workout
exclude: Weightlifting, machines, barbell (goes to Fitness & Gym Motivation)

categories.name: Fitness & Gym Motivation
categories.definition: Gym workouts, weightlifting, physique updates, body transformation, nutrition, and workout motivation.
include: Weightlifting, dumbbell/barbell workouts, gym machines
Physique showcases, bodybuilding, gym transformation
High-protein diet/nutrition for muscle building
Gym motivation/edits (use Fitness even if caption is motivational as long as it is about gym/lifting/physique)
exclude: Bodyweight calisthenics workouts (goes to Calisthenics & Bodyweight Training)
Non-fitness mindset/discipline posts (goes to Self-Improvement & Motivation)
Dance tutorials or choreography (goes to Dance & Performing Arts)

categories.name: Marvel & Superhero Edits
categories.definition: Fan edits, cinematic clips, and digital art centered on MCU, DC, or superhero characters.
include: Any edit centered on MCU, Avengers, Spider-Man, Batman, DC, or superhero characters
Behind the scenes, comic book movie edits
exclude: Non-superhero movie or TV show edits (goes to Movie, TV & Anime Fan Edits)

categories.name: Movie, TV & Anime Fan Edits
categories.definition: Fan edits of TV shows, movies, actors, animation, anime, and nostalgia clips (non-superhero).
include: Non-superhero movie clips and fan edits (e.g. Friends, Oppenheimer, Peaky Blinders)
Anime edits, aesthetic film cinematography edits
Celebrity/actor edit clips and aesthetic film clips
exclude: Marvel, DC, or superhero edits (goes to Marvel & Superhero Edits)
Music-led artist / lyric edits (goes to Music & Lyric Edits)

categories.name: Movie & Series Recommendations
categories.definition: Curated watchlists, film reviews, cinema recommendations, and TV show rankings.
include: Lists of movies/series to watch ('Top 5 Thrillers on Netflix')
Film suggestions, plot summaries, cinema reviews
exclude: Edits focusing purely on aesthetic music/clips without recommendation context (goes to Movie, TV & Anime Fan Edits)

categories.name: Dating, Flirting & Relationships (Rizz)
categories.definition: Flirting techniques, relationship advice, long-distance relationship moments, rizz lines, and romance.
include: Flirting/rizz lines, text conversation breakdowns
Couple goals, long-distance relationship (LDR) ideas
Relationship advice, dating tips and humor
exclude: Solo self-improvement mindset tips (goes to Self-Improvement & Motivation)

categories.name: Self-Improvement & Motivation
categories.definition: Mindset shifts, self-discipline, personal growth, daily habits, and non-fitness life wisdom.
include: Mindset, focus, discipline, overcoming laziness
Philosophical quotes, stoicism, life advice
Non-fitness personal development
Study and student content (#studygram, #mathematics)
exclude: Gym, lifting, physique, or workout posts (goes to Fitness & Gym Motivation even if motivational)
Aesthetic vibe posts without self-improvement/study focus

categories.name: Girl Edits (Typeshi)
categories.definition: Edits, fancams, and aesthetic clips centered on women (actresses, models, creators, characters).
include: Fancams and edits of women, actresses, female models, female characters
Aesthetic video clips centered on women
exclude: General non-female movie/show fan edits (goes to Movie, TV & Anime Fan Edits)
Marvel or superhero edits (goes to Marvel & Superhero Edits)

categories.name: Content Creation & Video Editing Tips
categories.definition: Advice, tools, and tutorials for video editing, filming, photography, and content creation.
include: Video editing apps (CapCut, Premiere)
Camera and lighting setups
Content strategy and engagement tips
exclude: General work/AI productivity tools (goes to Work & AI Tools)

categories.name: Humor & Memes
categories.definition: Comedy skits, memes, pranks, and relatable jokes.
include: Comedy skits, stand-up clips, relatable text-based jokes
Pranks, funny fails
exclude: Fan edits of actors or shows without explicit humor (goes to Movie, TV & Anime Fan Edits)
Movie facts (goes to Movie & Series Recommendations)
Non-English reposts without clear humor (goes to Other/Catch-all)

categories.name: Poetry & Quotes
categories.definition: Spoken word, romantic quotes, deep poetry, and text-based quote graphics.
include: Poetry reading, deep emotional quotes
Text overlay aesthetic quotes
exclude: Motivational discipline quotes (goes to Self-Improvement & Motivation)

categories.name: Music & Lyric Edits
categories.definition: Music-led posts, artist/lyric/song-driven edits (e.g. Radiohead, One Direction), song recommendations, and instrumental playing.
include: Artist/lyric/song-driven edits (e.g. Radiohead, One Direction, lyric edits)
Music-led posts, song recommendations
Live performances, guitar/piano covers
Song discovery, music production, lyric videos
exclude: Movie & Series Recommendations (if it's about the movie watchlists, use Movie & Series Recommendations)

categories.name: Fashion & Grooming
categories.definition: Clothing hauls, styling tips, grooming routines, and fashion.
include: Outfit of the day (OOTD), styling advice
Skincare, haircuts, and grooming
exclude: General aesthetic vibe videos without fashion focus (goes to Aesthetic & Lifestyle Vibe (Typeshi))

categories.name: Travel & Places
categories.definition: Travel hacks, destinations, itineraries, cultural festivals, and places.
include: Travel guides, holiday destinations
Cultural festivals, landmarks, city tours
Travel hacks, hotel/flight tips

categories.name: Dance & Performing Arts
categories.definition: Choreography, hook step tutorials, dance trends, and stage performances.
include: Hook step tutorials, choreography
Dance trends, Bollywood or song-based dance reels
Hip-hop, classical, or urban dance performances
exclude: Fitness/gym workouts (goes to Fitness & Gym Motivation)
Movie scenes that just happen to have dancing but are movie fan edits (goes to Movie, TV & Anime Fan Edits)

categories.name: Other / Catch-all
categories.definition: Miscellaneous posts that do not fit into any specific category.
include: Unique magic tricks, unusual hobbies, isolated random clips
exclude: Any post that clearly fits one of the specific categories above
